root_cause.text: The `mpu3050_trigger_probe()` function fails to release the interrupt handler registered via `request_threaded_irq()` when the subsequent `iio_trigger_register()` call fails, causing a resource leak.
root_cause.evidence: The patch shows that when `iio_trigger_register(mpu3050->trig)` fails at line 1130, the function previously returned immediately without calling `free_irq()` to release the interrupt handler that was allocated earlier by `request_threaded_irq()`. The fix adds an error handling path (`err_iio_trigger` label) that calls `free_irq(mpu3050->irq, mpu3050->trig)` before returning, ensuring proper cleanup of the interrupt resource on failure paths.
